creator: Navneet Prabhakar
comparison: Exact bitwise equality of all model and optimizer tensors, identical final counters, recipe, dataset/tokenizer/config and logical plan. No relaxed tolerance or optimizer reset.
compute_accounting: One diagnostic replay update is additional physical work, counted separately. It does not add unique tokens or increase the final model's logical exposure; each chain stays inside the same cumulative plan limits.
failure_rule: Retain any mismatch as a failed actual local resume diagnostic; investigate without changing the declared equality criterion.
limitations: One local learned-checkpoint resume boundary only; not a crash test, arbitrary interruption coverage, cross-backend quality gate or broad language capability proof. If no valid step-1024 checkpoint remains, report unavailable rather than restarting the original run.
